decisions.decision: Board accepted and approved the Utility Net Book Personal Property Values as submitted by Boston Gas Co., New England Power Co., MA Electric Co., and Unitil/ Fitchburg Gas & Electric.
decisions.quote: board accepted and approved the values as submitted by each company.

decisions.decision: Board accepted and approved the Sales Report Cover Letter (the Board agrees to review and approve full and fair cash valuations before submission to the Bureau of Local Assessment).
Board agreed to support the AT&T settlement (waiving appeals since 2004 in exchange for adopting AT&T's depreciation schedule), and Chris Comeau signed the agreement.
decisions.quote: board agreed and chris comeau signed the agreement

decisions.decision: Board reviewed and approved the FY2011 Sewer Betterment abatement, not to affect the overlay, for the Lunenburg Village 40B project.
decisions.quote: the board reviewed and approved the fiscal year 2011 sewer betterment abatement / not to affect the overlay.

decisions.decision: Majority of the Board used its discretion to continue a Veteran (V1) exemption for an applicant whose domicile is no longer in Lunenburg.
decisions.quote: the majority of the board used their discretion in deciding that the vet after many years of receiving the exemption should continue to be granted the exemption at this time.

decisions.decision: Board approved 99 statutory exemption applications and denied one senior Clause 17D / ED application for having less than 5 years of ownership of the property in Lunenburg.
decisions.quote: the board approved 99 applications for exemptions and denied one senior clause 17d / ed application

decisions.decision: Chair requested that the Administrative Assistant continue to bring forward questions for discussion regarding eligibility requirements for any individuals.
decisions.quote: chris requested that louise continue to bring torward questions for discussion regarding eligibility requirements for any individuals.

decisions.decision: Regional Assessor will mail notifications of the supplemental abatement denials.
Administrative Assistant will send out notice of the next meeting and agenda.
decisions.quote: louise will send out notice of meeting and agenda.
